product.description: Cauți o modalitate simplă de a-ți crește nivelul de energie, de a-ți imbunătăți starea de sănătate, de a slăbi și de a te simți fantastic?REŢETE DE SUCURI ŞI SMOOTHIES PENTRU SUPERENERGIE este o colecție uimitoare de băuturi care te fac să te simți bine, folosind cea mai nouă gamă de superalimente pentru a-ți hrăni și revitaliza corpul. CHRISTINE BAILEY este nutriționist premiat, consultant in domeniul sănătății și al alimentației, chef și profesor la o școală de bucătari. Bailey conduce două clinici, oferă ajutor in materie de nutriție companiilor specializate in alimente sănătoase, corporațiilor și autorităților locale și lucrează cu mai multe școli și organizații caritabile. Membră a Guild of Health Writers, scrie pentru numeroase reviste de gastronomie și de sănătate. De aceeași autoare, la Editura Litera au apărut Dieta cu sucuri naturale și Dieta cu alimente crude.

# Recipes for Superenergy: Juices and Smoothies for Optimal Health

Unlock your body's full potential with "Recipes for Superenergy," a collection designed to help you increase your energy levels, improve your overall health, support weight loss, and feel fantastic. This book is your guide to harnessing the power of the most potent superfoods through simple, delicious juice and smoothie recipes.

## Fuel Your Body with Superfoods

Discover an incredible collection of beverages crafted to nourish and revitalize your body using the newest range of superfoods. This book provides easy-to-follow recipes that make healthy eating accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Whether you are looking to boost your daily energy or embark on a healthier lifestyle, these recipes offer a practical path to achieving your wellness goals.

## Expert Guidance for Optimal Nutrition

This collection is brought to you by CHRISTINE BAILEY, a renowned nutritionist, health consultant, chef, and professor. Ms. Bailey brings unparalleled expertise to this book, drawing from her extensive experience in nutrition and healthy eating. She leads two clinics, advises specialized food companies, and works with various schools and charitable organizations, establishing her as a trusted authority in the field of wellness.

## Why Choose These Recipes?

*   **Boost Energy:** Utilize powerful superfoods to naturally increase your energy levels throughout the day.
*   **Improve Health:** Incorporate nutrient-dense drinks to support overall physical well-being.
*   **Support Weight Management:** Discover recipes that help you achieve your slimming goals naturally.
*   **Simple & Delicious:** Enjoy easy-to-prepare recipes that make healthy living a delightful experience.

## Product Details

**Brand:** Litera
**Category:** Books
**Price:** $59.99

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who is the author of this book?**
A: The book was written by Christine Bailey, an award-winning nutritionist and health consultant.

**Q: Are these recipes suitable for beginners?**
A: Yes, this collection features simple and straightforward recipes designed to be easily followed by anyone looking to improve their nutrition.

**Q: What is the focus of the book?**
A: The book focuses on creating juices and smoothies using superfoods to enhance energy, health, and vitality.
